kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the cytokine roster; the USMLE question attack structure is a KYP design.
kypExtensions.location: usmle section (patterns, traps, pivots, miniCase) + recall/rapidReview

kypExtensions.summary: Organizing the roster as a four-beat command sequence (acute alarm → recruitment → expansion → polarization/attenuation) with the Th1/Th2 cross-regulation seesaw, the IL-12 axis failure pattern (disseminated atypical mycobacteria/Salmonella → IFN-γ therapy), and the cytokine-drug bridge (IL-2R blockade, calcineurin inhibitors, anti-TNF, anti-IL-1/6/12/23/17/5).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source lists cytokines by cell without the timeline, the seesaw, the deficiency pattern, or the drug linkages; these integrations are KYP's design. Drug names and deficiency genetics are labeled extension (pharmacology/immunodeficiency content beyond this printed page).
kypExtensions.location: mechanism caption + callout + patterns 1 and 3 + mnemonics + miniCase
